verdict.rationale: Maritime documents cron triggers that wake an agent and deliver a prompt on each fire, agents that can turn natural-language schedules into real wake triggers, and signed webhooks POSTed on every agent lifecycle event. Most of this is time-based scheduling or outbound notification rather than user-defined event→action rules. missing for 10: a general rule/condition engine for arbitrary event-triggered actions, inbound event triggers beyond cron and lifecycle webhooks, documented rule configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
